es-MX.auth.reset.passwordEntirelyNumeric: La contraseña no puede ser solo números.
es-MX.auth.reset.passwordTooSimilar: La contraseña se parece demasiado a tus datos. Elige otra.

es-MX.sync.result.voidTargetNotFound: El registro que querías anular no existe en el servidor. Avisa a tu supervisor.
es-MX.sync.result.voidTargetNotOwned: Solo quien capturó un registro puede anularlo. Pídele a tu supervisor que lo corrija.
es-MX.sync.result.alreadyVoided: Este registro ya estaba anulado. No tienes que hacer nada más.
es-MX.sync.result.clockSkew: La hora de tu teléfono parece estar mal, así que un supervisor revisará este registro. Revisa la fecha y la hora del teléfono.
es-MX.sync.result.finalUploadAfterRevoke: Tu sesión ya había terminado cuando se envió este registro, así que un supervisor lo revisará. Inicia sesión de nuevo si necesitas seguir trabajando.
es-MX.sync.batch.deviceMismatch: La sesión no corresponde a este teléfono. Inicia sesión de nuevo.
es-MX.sync.batch.payloadTooLarge: El envío era demasiado grande, así que la app lo enviará en partes. No tienes que hacer nada.
es-MX.sync.batch.invalidCursor: No pudimos actualizar tu bandeja, así que la app la pedirá completa otra vez. No tienes que hacer nada.
es-MX.sync.batch.syncInProgress: Ya se está enviando información de tu cuenta desde otro teléfono. La app lo intentará de nuevo en unos segundos.

en.sync.inbox.acceptedHint: The server received this record. You have nothing else to do.
en.sync.inbox.rejectedHint: The server couldn't accept this record. Ask your supervisor to review it.
en.sync.inbox.inReviewHint: A supervisor will review this record. You don't need to do anything meanwhile.
en.sync.result.unsupportedEventType: The server doesn't recognize this type of record. Update the app and try again; if it keeps happening, tell your supervisor.
en.sync.result.unsupportedSchemaVersion: This record uses a format the server doesn't recognize. Update the app to be able to send it.
en.sync.result.invalidPayload: Some data in this record is not valid. Review it; if you can't fix it, tell your supervisor.
en.sync.result.eventPayloadTooLarge: This record is too large to send. Tell your supervisor.
en.sync.result.eventIdConflict: This record clashes with another one that already exists on the server. Tell your supervisor and don't capture it again.
en.sync.result.voidTargetNotFound: The record you wanted to void doesn't exist on the server. Tell your supervisor.
en.sync.result.voidTargetNotOwned: Only the person who captured a record can void it. Ask your supervisor to correct it.
en.sync.result.alreadyVoided: This record was already voided. You have nothing else to do.
en.sync.result.clockSkew: Your phone's clock looks wrong, so a supervisor will review this record. Check the date and time on your phone.
en.sync.result.finalUploadAfterRevoke: Your session had already ended when this record was sent, so a supervisor will review it. Sign in again if you need to keep working.
en.sync.batch.deviceMismatch: This session doesn't belong to this phone. Sign in again.
en.sync.batch.payloadTooLarge: The upload was too large, so the app will send it in parts. You don't need to do anything.
en.sync.batch.invalidCursor: We couldn't refresh your inbox, so the app will load it in full again. You don't need to do anything.
en.sync.batch.syncInProgress: Information from your account is already being sent from another phone. The app will try again in a few seconds.
